pullRequest.body: ## Summary - add `@mcpfn/core`, `@mcpfn/auth`, `@mcpfn/testing`, `@mcpfn/datafn`, and `@mcpfn/cli` - provide official-SDK-backed tools, resources, prompts, tasks, MCP Apps contracts, deterministic manifests, compatibility diffs, semantic scenarios, OAuth/API-key regression fixtures, and host profiles - integrate McpFn with DataFn, LangFn, MemoryFn, and ProbeFn while preserving their public behavior and sanitizing exposed results - add calculator/conformance examples, package/release registration, documentation, and a dedicated conservative CI release gate - include the required `.conduct` completion record for the `next` target ## Notable safeguards - OAuth resource servers reject missing or incorrect resource bindings - DataFn exposure is deny-by-default and validates runtime/schema parity - MemoryFn MCP responses project explicit public DTOs instead of leaking storage internals - CLI misuse returns stable non-zero exit codes - mixed/global changes still run generic JavaScript CI in addition to the McpFn gate ## Verification - `npm run gate:mcpfn-release` — passed all 43 steps - official MCP conformance — passed - reusable OAuth/API-key Vitest matrix and Chromium Playwright flow — passed - DataFn server and adapter suites — passed - LangFn — 12 files / 53 tests passed - MemoryFn MCP regression test — passed - ProbeFn MCP suite — 6 tests passed - ESM/CJS imports, testing subpath imports, five package dry-runs, and docs inventory — passed - `npm ci --dry-run --ignore-scripts` — passed - `git diff --check` — passed --- ## Summary by cubic Introduce McpFn: a framework to build and regression-test MCP servers on the official SDK with safe DataFn exposure, OAuth resource-server security, and deterministic contracts. It integrates with LangFn, MemoryFn, and ProbeFn, adds a CLI and CI release gate, and keeps public behavior stable. - **New Features** - Added `@mcpfn/core` (registry/server on the official SDK, manifests, compatibility diffs), `@mcpfn/auth` (RFC 9728 protected-resource and token verification), `@mcpfn/testing` (official client, scenarios, OAuth/PKCE fixtures, Playwright helpers, host profiles, conformance orchestration), `@mcpfn/datafn` (deny-by-default DataFn adapter), and `@mcpfn/cli` (manifest, validate, diff, test, conformance). - Deterministic manifests with breaking/additive/model-behavior classification and `mcpfn diff` to guard compatibility. - OAuth resource servers enforce resource binding, scopes, expiry, and revocation; trusted `authInfo` flows into MCP handlers. - Contract and semantic regression suites (API key and OAuth matrices, structured/text parity) plus an official conformance runner. - CI: new McpFn release gate (`gate:mcpfn-release`) and a dedicated GitHub Actions job. - **Refactors** - LangFn and MemoryFn now expose tools via the official MCP SDK through `@mcpfn/core`; replaced custom stdio/SSE transports with SDK transports; outputs use explicit structured results. - DataFn: added an executor surface and a safe MCP adapter that validates schema/runtime parity, enforces projections and idempotent writes, and preserves authorization/namespace/policy/hooks. - ProbeFn and LangFn dependencies updated to `@mcpfn/core`/`@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`; added examples (calculator server, conformance server) and end-to-end tests. Written for commit 416303247a22b3e15b06d51c9124b8678a0f599f. Summary will update on new commits.
